description: Which on-chain series are available? Lists all 67 available Bitcoin Research Kit (BRK) on-chain series across the groups pilot, sentiment, mining, supply, cointime, activity, liquidity (e.g. MVRV, NUPL, SOPR, Realized-Price, Mayer, Puell, STH/LTH SOPR, Hash-Ribbons). Returns id + label + group. Use the id with arena_get_onchain_latest / _history. [Free tier]
name: arena_list_onchain_series
